names: Lactic acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
display_name: E472b (Lactic acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids)

more_info.overview: Lactic acid esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.origin: A mixture of glycerol esters containing lactic acid and fatty acids from food fats or oils. The specification does not establish a single animal or plant source for the fatty-acid component.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The fatty-acid feedstock is not specified as exclusively plant derived. Vegan, vegetarian, halal and kosher suitability cannot be established without the supplier identifying the raw material and processing.
